title: Prospective Evaluation Of Delayed Effects Of Pediatric Car T Cell Therapy
official: Prospective Evaluation Of Delayed Effects Of Pediatric Car T Cell Therapy (PROSPER)
summary: This study is being done to learn more about the short-term and long-term side effects of CAR-T cell therapy. Specifically, researchers want to know how often patients get infections, have delays in recovering blood cell counts and/or have damage to the nervous system.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participants must have received an initial systemically-administered CAR T cell infusion for an oncologic diagnosis within the last 1-3 months (+/- 14 days).

  * Initial infusion is defined as the first administration of a CAR T cell product the participant has not previously received OR receipt of a CAR T cell product previously received after an interval allogeneic HSCT.
* Age ≤ 30 years at CAR T cell infusion.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active malignancy other than the disease under study.
* Planned consolidative HSCT within 3 months post CAR T cell infusion.
* Received or planned additional disease directed therapy post CAR T cell infusion.
* Inability or unwillingness of research participant or legal guardian/representative to give written informed consent.
